question: Which complaint types with more than 3000 total requests from 2011 to 2020 show the strongest positive and negative Pearson correlations with the daily average wind speed measured at station 744860 (JFK Airport), based on daily complaint proportions (the ratio of type-specific complaints to total daily complaints)? Please provide the complaint types and their correlation coefficients, rounded to four decimal places.

WITH daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
complaint_types_filter AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000
),
wind_data AS (
  SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020` WHERE stn = '744860'
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.complaint_type,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.type_count, dt.daily_total) as daily_proportion,
    w.wdsp
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.complaint_date = dt.complaint_date
  JOIN wind_data w ON dc.complaint_date = w.weather_date
  WHERE dc.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM complaint_types_filter)
),
means AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, AVG(daily_proportion) as mean_prop, AVG(wdsp) as mean_wind
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
centered AS (
  SELECT j.complaint_type,
    j.daily_proportion - m.mean_prop as x,
    j.wdsp - m.mean_wind as y
  FROM joined j
  JOIN means m ON j.complaint_type = m.complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  ROUND(CORR(x, y), 4) as pearson_corr
FROM centered
GROUP BY complaint_type
ORDER BY ABS(pearson_corr) DESC
LIMIT 2
